_readme: S741, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-27). American River 39731 and 39732 (Refrigeration Service Technician Apprenticeship Level I and Level II certificates) were both read from PDF p.211, which opens mid-table: each record holds the same 31-course list and a 16-unit work experience list under 'Total Units: 48', and each one's note says its heading sits on an earlier page. They hold as not shown to be the program's own. This read prints pp.209-212 whole, so a session can see which headings the catalog prints for the Refrigeration Service Technician awards, where each one's list starts and what total each prints. One load of the hand-filed copy's address, no model call, nothing written.

questions.refrigeration_sections: The headings of the Refrigeration Service Technician Apprenticeship awards on pp.209-212, the rule line above each course list, and each award's Total Units.
